Mass Import txt File:

Design : https://xd.adobe.com/view/da11392b-b666-46e7-b12c-44e30f397637-8f42/screen/85750a80-fbd8-493a-8f72-9d2d0b26136a/

As a system user

I want to be able to import payment’ data in system using xlsx file to create payments

So that I can easily manage multiple payment in the system and adjust their data

Mass Import File:
txt file , should have 2 types of import file structure with different fields.
first structure is for collection channel which type of file is payment partner and second structure is for collection channel which type of file is bank partner.

Payment import Process:
If payment can't be imported because customer doesn't exist - put this  payment for hardcoded customer ( 000000000)

If customer exists but billing group doesn't match  - put this  payment for this customer (no hardcoded customer)

we should Create automatic Receivable for payment (from mass import) if after offsetting process payment current amount more than 0, it’s possible payment don’t offset At least in this case we also have to create receivable

Acceptance criteria 

  1. To be able to see Mass import icon in Payments listing page if user have permission:

    1. Creating a Payment via Mass import

    2. NOTE: editing operations aren’t allowed via mass import

  2. After clicking on Mass import icon will open mass import page with possibility to: 

    1. Collection channel

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

        1. Collection channels

          1. Display only Active collection channels

          2. Display only Collection channels with type: offline

        2. Only the name should be displayed

        3. Order should be alphabetical

        4. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

          1. It is possible to search the by its name

        5. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

    2. Date of payment

      1. Mandatory

      2. Date picker

      3. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      4. Data should be displayed in between 01.01.1990 to 31.12.2090

      5. It is possible to define date as current day or in the Past/future

    3. File Import:

      1. Choose txt file to upload

      2. Import button

        1. Clicking on Import button will check file structure

          1. If file structure is correct system will automatically create and start process for payment import in system

          2. If file structure is not correct, system should display a warning message

          3. After starting process user will be able to see/manage process from Processes page in system settings module 

    4. Cancel button

      1. Check changes and if there are changes made then Warning Pop-up message comes out with buttons: “Your changes are not saved, are you sure you want to cancel mass import?” Yes/No 

        1. Yes – will close pop-up and return to payment listing page

        2. No – will close page and user stays on mass import page

        3. Warning message is managed via system message configuration

      2. If no changes, then directly return to payment listing page

    5. txt file template will have predefined 2 type structure

      1. First type structure is for offline collection channel which type of file is payment partner

        1. In this txt structure system should read following fields:

          1. Customer number

            1. Start position - 1

            2. Length - 16

            3. Example
              6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 70010
              Customer number will be 6000054048

          2. Customer identifier (UIC)

            1. Start position - 17

            2. Length - 10

            3. Example
              6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
              Customer identifier will be 205342928

            4. Should find customer with this UIC and and add it to payment as a sub-object (connection is ID)

          3. Billing group number

            1. Start position - 28

            2. Length - 20

            3. Example
              6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
              Customer identifier will be 205342928
              Billing group will be empty

            4. In payment object Billing group sub-object shouldn’t be added

            5. If billing group value in example should be filled System should find this billing group with its number and add in payment object as billing group a sub-object

          4. Invoice prefix

            1. Start position - 47

            2. Length - 3

            3. Example
              6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
              Invoice prefix will be EE

          5. Invoice Number

            1. Start position - 49

            2. Length - 10

            3. Example
              6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
              Invoice number will be 0416915113

            4. System should find invoice with Prefix & Invoice number, EE04169151135 and add it to payment object as a outgoing document Sub-object

          6. Amount with decimal dot

            1. Start position - 59

            2. Length - 10

            3. Example
              6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
              Amount will be 523.12

            4. System should input value in initial amount and current amount field

        2. In length counting for all field should include spaces, but when input value in payment object value should be trimmed and shouldn’t include spaces

        3. In txt file new row means new payment, separator for each payment should be row

        4. Before start importing process system should check file structure and collection channel’s type of file, are this txt file valid for this collection channel type ?

          1. If yes start import process

          2. If no display error in processes

        5. Process should create new payment object for each row in txt file

        6. Another fields for creating payment object which aren’t in txt file

          1. Collection channel

            1. In payment object Set same value which is filled in mass import object’s collection channel field

          2. Payment date

            1. In payment object Set same value which is filled in mass import object’s date of payment field

          3. Payment package

            1. Should be generate new payment package for every mass import

            2. Collection channel should be same which is filled in mass import object’s collection channel field

            3. Payment date should be same which is filled in mass import object’s date of payment field

            4. Accounting period should be for month according to payment date

          4. Accounting period

            1. Accounting period should be for month according to payment date

          5. Currency

            1. Default currency

      2. Second type structure is for offline collection channel which type of file is bank partner

        1. in this txt file System should find following initials and read text after it before next initial

          1. Initial to search :31:

            1. Initial meaning: Account identification for all payment, ENERGO-PRO IBAN

            2. Should be used for all payment

            3. This initial should be one time in txt file

            4. If there is more then one initial display error

            5. Read text after initial before next initial is started, next initial starting value is “:”, so read text after :31: before :

            6. Example
              :31:BG20STSA93000024288530
              Catch following BG20STSA93000024288530

            7. System should input value in additional payment information field

          2. Initial to search :60F:

            1. Initial meaning: Currency

            2. Should be used for all payment

            3. This initial should be one time in txt file

            4. If there is more then one initial display error

            5. Search text ‘BGN’ or ‘EUR’ after initial before next initial is started, next initial starting value is “:”

            6. If Search returning more then one value display error

            7. Example
              :60F:C240315BGN24950,12
              :61:2403150315C657,96N022000001//290290300117817
              TC36-TSC00
              Should search ‘BGN’ or ‘EUR’ in C240315BGN24950,12 text.
              Result will bi BGN

            8. If searched text is ‘BGN’ System should input leva in currency field, if searched text is ‘EUR’ system should input euro in currency field

          3. Initial to search :61:

            1. Initial meaning: Payment date, Amount, Reference

            2. Quantity of this initial determines quantity of payment which should be created

            3. Quantity of this initial should be equal quantity of :86: initial.

            4. If Quantity of this initial isn’t equal to quantity of :86: initial display error

            5. Each of this initial should be before :86: initial

            6. If any of this initial isn’t before :86: initial display error and terminate the import process for this file.

            7. Read payment date after initial first 6 number, Format: YYMMDD.
              System should input it payment date field

            8. Find ‘C' and 'N’ after initial and read text between them, this will be amount (consider to convert comma to decimal)
              System should input it in initial amount and current amount field

            9. Find 'N' after initial and read text after it before new line
              System should input it in additional payment information field

            10. Example
              :61:2403150315C1297,30N022000006//067009992101711
              TC15-TSC81
              :NS:191010+
              Payment date: 240315 == 15 march 2024
              Amount: 1297,30 == 1297.30
              Reference: 022000006//067009992101711

          4. Initial to search :86:

            1. Initial meaning: Customer number, Invoice prefix & invoice number

            2. Quantity of this initial determines quantity of payment which should be created

            3. Quantity of this initial should be equal quantity of :61: initial

            4. If Quantity of this initial isn’t equal to quantity of :61: initial display error

            5. Each of this initial should be after :61: initial

            6. If any of this initial isn’t before :61: initial display error

            7. Find ‘ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯’ text after initial, search 15 digits after ‘ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯’, trim it, after trim first 3 digit will be invoice prefix. search 10 digits in trimmed text after 3 digits ( from 4th to 14th) this will invoice number
              Find invoice in system with this invoice prefix & invoice number and input it in outgoing document sub-object

            8. Find first + after ‘ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯’ text, find first space after +, search 10 digits after space
              This will be customer number
              Find customer with customer number and input it in customer sub-object (connection is customer ID)

            9. Example
              :86:020+14+
              20ÐÐ¢ÐÐ ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ ÐÐ. ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯ Ð¤Ð¢,04169156+
              2150Ð¤Ð¢0416915650, 6000031125,00000000+
              30CECB9790+
              31BG59CECB97901005191400+
              32ÐÐ ÐÐÐÐ Ð¦Ð ÐÐÐÐÐÐÐÐ¡ÐÐ ÐÐÐÐÐÐ +
              33ÐÐ¦ÐÐ¯
              :61:2403150315C552,14N022000020//297297009961502
              TC14-TSC30

            10. Read exact invoice prefix+number and customer number. another characters shouldn’t be included in txt file.

        2. Before start importing process system should check file structure and collection channel’s type of file, are this txt file valid for this collection channel type ?

          1. If yes start import process

          2. If no display error in processes

        3. Process should create new payment object for each :61: and :86: in txt file

        4. Another fields for creating payment object which aren’t in txt file

          1. Collection channel

            1. In payment object Set same value which is filled in mass import object’s collection channel field

          2. Payment package

            1. Should be generate new payment package for every mass import

            2. Collection channel should be same which is filled in mass import object’s collection channel field

            3. Payment date should be same which is filled in mass import object’s date of payment field

            4. Accounting period should be for month according to payment date

          3. Accounting period

            1. Accounting period should be for month according to payment date

    6. All Payment related data should be possible to import

      1. If there is Mandatory field missing, should have error and should not create the payment.

      2. if there is optional field missing, should create payment without this field.

      3. If there are error in a row, no matter it is error from mandatory fields or optional, in this case this payment will not be created

    7. To display in report exact row and exact field in which error happened

    8. In start process system should have actions:

      1. Pause

        1. To be able to pause process

        2. Already imported customer payment will be visible in system

      2. Resume

        1. Action is available on Paused process

        2. After resuming process will continue from the point where it was paused

      3. Cancel

        1. User  have possibility to Cancel process

        2. Changes will stay in the system and no possibility to revert changes

    9. Audit Log record should be created for create/edit customer payment

    10. Audit Log record should be created for mass import process itself and all changes should be logged:

      1. When mass import process was started

      2. When mass import process was paused/resumed

      3. When mass import process was completed

      4. When mass import process was cancelled

      5. When completing mass import process, report in excel file is generated

        1. It is possible to download report from process detail page

          1. How many records were imported successfully

          2. How many records were failed (display row number and fields name in which error happened)

    11. When process is completed, notification should be sent automatically, who started the process will get notification
